title: Daniel Muallem — textured skeuomorphism
note: How far a basic vector animation can be pushed into something that feels almost physical. Process: vector shapes designed and animated from scratch, then AI rendering turns them into sculptural metallic objects while preserving the motion, finished in After Effects. A 4-second loop of chrome/black metallic pawn-like forms on light grey. She dropped it with Cool textured skeumorphism inspo. It covers the metal slot in her texture-library project — Paper River covered paper, this covers metal.
